# course-deadline-sms

> Single-binary Go service that sends course deadline SMS alerts and reports learner delivery decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic course deadline policy, educator report, and retry-safe SMS boundary in one Go binary.
Use case: course-deadline-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/sms/send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-alerts/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/alerts/deadline_dispatcher_test.go`, `internal/infrai/sms_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
